Select exact IC50 activity rows for human Cytochrome P450 3A4. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target name 'Cytochrome P450 3A4' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' with standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
